column1: # What a run of the launcher's stack may leave on a machine, each with why (tests/leftovers.md,
# "Kept by design"). kind<TAB>where (clone, shared or any)<TAB>glob on the name the report shows
# (`*`, `?`, `[0-9]`; `!` first: may NOT leave, the first entry that matches deciding)<TAB>reason.
# A caller adds its own with `--allow <file>`, in the same format.

column4: the images a lab pulls or builds stay, the launcher's cache (recorded in storage.json; the Machine page's Clean up removes them)
a volume a lab marks persistent (isoloom.persistent) outlives its stop on purpose
the boxes a VM lab or the guided setup's self-test downloads stay, the launcher's cache (the Machine page's Clean up removes them)
vagrant-libvirt's copy of a box in the storage pool: the box cache, kept for the next VM
the master VM Vagrant imports from a box for linked clones (`<box>_<ms>_<n>`): the box cache, kept for the next VM
the host-only adapter Vagrant makes for a private network (the setup self-test's 192.168.56.0/24): Vagrant never removes it and the next VM reuses it
VirtualBox 7's host-only network Vagrant makes on a Mac for a private network: Vagrant never removes it and the next VM reuses it
the DHCP server of the host-only adapter above: Vagrant never removes it and the next VM reuses it
the host-only adapter above as Windows names it (VirtualBox Host-Only Ethernet Adapter, #n after the first): Vagrant never removes it and the next VM reuses it
the route of the host-only adapter above (the setup self-test's 192.168.56.0/24): up as long as the adapter is, so kept with it
the same route on Windows, through the adapter as Windows names it: up as long as the adapter is, so kept with it
Isothrum's lock of a run, kept with its record (runs/<run>/record.json) by design: the OS releases it when its holder exits
Isothrum's lock of the slots, the app's: kept by design, released by the OS
the lock of storage.json (the launcher's record of its downloads), the app's: kept by design
the lock of installed-tools.json (the tools the guided setup installed), the app's: kept by design
the lock of the labs' instance numbers, the app's: kept by design
the launcher's own API token on a node, made when the node is set up (one a launcher key) and kept for its next lab
